title: Beach and Pool Front Spacious
description: Directly on the shore, awaken to the gentle song of waves and unparalleled views of the sparkling Caribbean. Two plush bedrooms and a sleek bathroom, ready to house up to five sun enthusiasts.Step onto the beach within 30 seconds or take a dip in our pool. Sun or swim, your tropical wish is our command! Experience a bustling world of exquisite eateries and vibrant nightlife right at your doorstep.Other things to noteThe western region of Puerto Rico is prone to short-term power outages. The property owner cannot guarantee uninterrupted electrical service during your stay and will not provide discounts, refunds, or alternative accommodations for outages lasting less than 24 hours. In the event of an outage exceeding 24 hours, the owner will refund the unused/remaining nights on the reservation, if the guest elects to vacate the premises entirely. While the owner is happy to provide guidance on making such interruptions more manageable, no liability shall be assumed for any inconvenience, damages, or losses resulting from a loss of power in the area.In addition, there is only one parking space, if you have additional vehicles, kindly park outside the gate in the grassy areas.

title: El Rinconcito Azul • Pool • 1 Block from the Beach
description: Escape to El Rinconcito Azul in Rincón’s desirable Córcega neighborhood! Located just 1 block from the beach, this cozy condo features a newly renovated pool, BBQ gazebos, dedicated parking, Wi-Fi and beach essentials for your stay. Minutes from downtown Rincón, restaurants, bars, markets and world-class surf beaches. Perfect for couples, families and beach lovers looking to enjoy Puerto Rico’s west coast.The spaceThe condo is located in a gated complex, just a short walk to the beach. Complex amenities include a pool, outdoor gazebo, BBQ grill access, basketball court. Laundry will be made available for stays more than 6 days. Nearby amenities include many bakeries, restaurants, gastro food trucks and world famous surf beaches. Rincon's vibrant downtown boasts grocery stores, boutiques, restaurants, bars and Rincon Brewery.Perfectly situated for both relaxation and exploring all that the west coast of Puerto Rico has to offer.Guest accessGuests have full access to the entire unit, plus shared outdoor amenities included pool, gazebo and BBQ grill.Other things to noteParking and gate access information will be provided after booking.Unit is on the 3rd floor and accessible by elevator.Guests must be 25+ to book.Absolutely no smoking in the unit. Please do not hang clothing or towels from balcony rails.Damage to unit, furniture, decor, towels or sheets will be charged directly to guests. Check out time is 11am sharp. Our cleaning crew will arrive promptly on the morning of check out to cleanse unit and prepare for our next guest. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated!

description: Available as a short or long term rental! 1 Minute to beach with jungle valley views. Your Puntas apartment has large airy bedrooms and big open living space with a sunny deck with outside shower. Fully stocked kitchen. Washer and dryer. The new yoga deck is a dream to practice on or star gaze at night!Private off street parking. Relaxing and close to all.Our home now runs on solar power! New Vegan or Seagan meals available! Breakfast, Sunday Brunch and Dinners. Inquire about options and prices!The spaceOur home is in the center of family friendly Puntas near all beaches and surf spots. We offer a clean, comfortable and relaxing place to enjoy your visit. Our property just got a little more green. We are now powered by the 🌞 sun! We just installed a 9.2Kw solar system. 23 panels charging two Tesla Powerwall batteries! When the grid fails, we don’t. 😎 All the rooms have very tall ceilings allowing lots of light and air-flow. There are fans throughout and windows are screened to keep bugs out. There is no AC. The private unit has jungle valley views and a deck with hammock and table with umbrella. Also an outdoor shower to rinse the sand away! A washing machine and dryer. And a new yoga deck good for a 2 mat practice-also an amazing spot to star gaze! Enjoy all the plants and flowers, including your very own pomegranate tree! We do have a strict quiet after 10pm rule as noise travels through all the open windows and can wake other guests sleeping above or bellow you;) We are a property best suited for nature lovers, water sports enthusiasts and adventure seekers. Those who wish for a more hangout party scene will not find this a good fit! New to the rental is a vegan meal plan!😉😉Guest accessOur guests have their own off street parking spot and can explore our 1.5 acres of lush and wild land(best to put your sneakers on).Our fruit trees produce: mango, bananas, oranges, pomegranate, and avocados to name a few.Other things to noteWe started and had Jack’s Shack food cart(which was a town favorite and number one on trip advisor;) for 7 yrs. And since selling it 2 yrs ago we miss cooking for folks so we decided just this week to open a meal service up to our guests. Please inquire about our fresh, local vegan or Seagan breakfast and dinner delivered directly to your rental! We run on solar power and also have a backup water system for any outages. Please borrow any of our beach or snorkel gear during your stay! Please note this Apartment has no AC.

description: Check out our house's perfect reviews here: airbnb.com/h/casagoyitaEnjoy paradise at Casa Goyita located right on Rincon's famous Lala's Beach and just a quick walk to downtown! Casa Goyita is an 8 Bedroom 4 Bath Duplex that sleeps 20 comfortably and offers a modern interior, spacious high ceilings, AC, WiFi, lovely terrace with outdoor kitchen, direct beach access via private path, shaded pavilion, and outdoor shower for rinsing off.The spaceThe spaceSpacious upstairs and downstairs units each feature two private entrances, one on front, one beach side. Reviews agree there is plenty of space in each for 10 (20 total) to stay in comfort. The most unique aspect is the beautiful backyard that opens directly onto Lala’s beach and one of the best Rincón areas for ocean swimming.Five bedrooms have a Queen bed, One has a Queen and Twin, and two bedrooms have a Queen bed plus Twin/Twin bunk beds. Master bedrooms have in suite bathrooms. Third and Forth bathrooms are off hallway, with an additional outdoor shower in the backyard.Guest accessThe entire house plus terrace, outdoor kitchen, path to beach, ample backyard, and shaded pergola are yours to enjoy.All beaches are public in Puerto Rico, so other beach goers will be on the sand and in their water, however, they can not see beyond the tree line so the backyard and terrace area retains privacy.PARKING.. on property behind the gate are four compact to mid-sized parking spots. Additional street parking is available on the MAIN STREET, wherever the curb is painted white, just a few yards from the house. NO PARKING IS ALLOWED IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE THE GATE TO THE PROPERTY. We know this isn’t ideal, but please help us keep our neighbors happy by not parking on Calle Cambija.Other things to noteThe house was built in the late 1970’s by Goyita Ruiz. The grounds are still lovingly cared for and maintained by her son, Julio, who often comes by in the late mornings to sweep and tidy the large property and will gladly to give you a local history lesson if you ask. There are free roaming chickens that can create a need to keep up with this. If you prefer during your stay to personally sweep and hose the terrace and walkway, please let us know prior to your check in.

description: Experience the charm of a refreshed serene oceanfront apartment in beautiful Corcega, Rincon.What You’ll Love:Spectacular Views: Enjoy uninterrupted ocean views from the balcony, where every evening treats you to a dazzling sunset over the water.Steps from the Beach: Fall asleep and wake up to the rhythm of the waves.Peaceful & Secure: Nestled in a gated community, the apartment is quiet, safe, and relaxing—perfect for couples, families, or solo travelers seeking tranquility.The spaceThis lovely apartment is located in the charming Porta del Sol Region (the beautiful west coast of Puerto Rico), where you'll hear both English and Spanish all around!The apartment is on the top floor (the third floor), so there's a bit of exercise involved since there's no elevator, but trust us, it's worth it! Fully furnished for your convenience, it features three ceiling fans to keep you cool and air conditioning in the bedrooms for those warmer nights. You'll find a fully furnished kitchen, a comfy queen bed, one double bed, and a TV in the living room to enjoy your favorite shows.The best part? You'll have a front-row seat to watch the most stunning sunset on the island and have direct access to the beach! And if you're up for a little stroll, another stunning beach is just 3-4 minutes away. Come and make wonderful memories in this lovely space!Guest accessThere is direct beach access to a small beach, two reserved parking spots, house amenities, and newly installed High-Speed Wi-Fi in the unit.Other things to noteRincón is famous for its breathtaking sunsets and perfect surfing waves, but it also offers snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Nearby, you can rent paddleboards, kayaks, and jet skis.Discover the best local restaurants and artisan shops in the heart of this vibrant coastal town.Thus, whether you want to unwind on the beach or explore the vibrant local culture, this location is ideal for both relaxation and adventure.Also, near the apartment, you can find bakeries, laundromats, grocery stores, pharmacies, gas stations, gift shops, and other stores that may have what you need.PRACTICAL INFORMATION: Best Time to Visit: Rincón is a year-round destination, but the best time for surfing is from November to April, while whale watching is best from January to March.Transportation:Renting a car is HIGHLY recommended to explore the area fully, as public transportation is extremely limited.Pricing:Our nightly rate includes the room tax.
